hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0
grep -Eq '"file_path" *: *"([^"]*/)?go\.sum"' && { echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit go.sum directly. Use go mod tidy.' >&2; exit 2; } || true
